bills.title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Streamlining Environmental Approvals) Bill 2020

name: The same number of senators voted for and against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2020-10-08.48.1) introduced by ACT Senator [Katy Gallagher](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/katy_gallagher) (Labor), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add "and, in respect of the [Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Streamlining Environmental Approvals) Bill 2020](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6582), the bill be referred immediately to the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 11 November 2020".*
question: The same number of senators voted for and against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2020-10-08.48.1) introduced by ACT Senator [Katy Gallagher](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/katy_gallagher) (Labor), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *At the end of the motion, add "and, in respect of the [Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Streamlining Environmental Approvals) Bill 2020](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r6582), the bill be referred immediately to the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee for inquiry and report by 11 November 2020".*
